title: Team infrastructure declaration
description: One file per team at teams/<team>/team.yaml. Mirrors the validation rules of modules/team-baseline.

team.description: Must equal the directory name. 3-24 lowercase letters/digits, no hyphens.

buckets.description: Buckets keyed by short name; the key becomes part of the bucket name.

visibility.description: Required, no default. Public buckets require platform/security approval before apply.

retention_days.description: Optional S3 Object Lock Compliance retention for each new object version; defaults to 90 days.
